# 2 Baruch Chapter 30 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Second Fast and Dialogue

---

**1** After all of this, when the time of the Anointed One's coming is complete, he will return in glory.

**2** Then all who have fallen asleep trusting in him will rise again. At that moment the heavenly treasuries will be thrown open — the places where the souls of the righteous have been preserved and kept in number — and they will pour out, and an enormous crowd of souls will appear all at once.

**3** Those who arrived first will rejoice, and those who arrived last will have no cause for grief.

**4** For every one of them will know that the appointed time has finally come.

**5** But the souls of the wicked — when they see all of this happening, they will utterly waste away. Because they will know that their punishment has arrived and their destruction is upon them.

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering of the resurrection and judgment. The opening of the treasuries is a dramatic cosmic event. The equity between "first" and "last" arrivals (v.3) suggests a community of the righteous dead in which seniority brings no advantage.*
